title: Candlelight: Tribute to Michael Jackson
seo_title: Candlelight: Tribute to Michael Jackson in Springfield, MO
description: Candlelight: Tribute to Michael Jackson is a live concert where you hear the music of Michael Jackson performed by candlelight. It is a tribute show, not affiliated with or endorsed by the artist, their estate, or official representatives, and it runs about 60 minutes with doors opening 45 minutes before. It takes place December 12, 2026 (Time TBD) at Stone Chapel at Drury University, 900 N Benton Ave, Springfield, MO.
